It happens at Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake. Hollis flagged it as open on Pree's dealer account before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. He flagged #4412 at the same time, a small glitch in the driver text-message prompt. I found no later status on either ticket.
- **West yard Door 2 double-booking (ticket #8841):** On 13 Oct 2026, in #central-random, Tobias said Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He'd raised it with support on #8841. He called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I told Hollis I'm assuming it's the same account and suggested he confirm with Tobias before putting it in the file.

I only used sources Hollis can see himself: #central-team, #central-random, public files and his own DM with me.
